submission.natural_language_explanation: Broad, position-weighted head: predict nearly every text active (about 90% of 64-token windows), usually weakly (0.25-0.45 of max) on its 2nd-4th tokens, and strong (above 0.5) when a '.', an opening '(' or a closing ')'/']'/'}' is among the first ~5 tokens ('1.', 'Sen.', 'Poly(', 'a)'), or when a text under ~16 tokens ends in '.'; this punctuation effect fades with position, and commas, other punctuation and words past ~8 tokens stay below the line. Predicted inactive: a single unpunctuated clause of 10-20 tokens that opens 'According to <noun phrase>' and contains no '.', ',', brackets or other punctuation anywhere (e.g. 'According to the map the nearest petrol station is about twenty miles away').
